name: jamielab
source: jamielab design system (Claude artifact) — snapshot 2026-09-24. Treat as the single source of truth; regenerate CSS/QSS from it, never hand-edit values downstream.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background — the terminal void everything sits on.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, panes, code blocks and modals, one step up from ground.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and table rules only (1.6:1); never a control border — use edge.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Input, button and card-outline borders; 3:1+ on ground and panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground or panel (14.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, placeholders (6.9:1 on ground).

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: The brand green: primary actions, the prompt caret, focus rings, success. Text on it is ground.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Links, info states, secondary highlights and selected rows.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warnings, pending states and 'specimen' labels; use sparingly.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only; always paired with an icon or text, never color alone.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and pane padding, form field gaps.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Terminal panes, tables, full-bleed code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and modals; the largest radius in the system.
